text:
Maya Patel: heads up — acme-prod is hitting a big p95 regression starting ~08:43 UTC, p95 jumped from ~2.5s to ~6.2s. Customer seeing increased 500s/timeouts. Trace: https://traces.redwood/internal/trace/abcd1234 :eyes:
Ajay Singh: can you paste tenant id + a sample request id? which model/route are they using?
Maya Patel: tenant: acme-inc (tenant_482). request id: req_0a1b2c3d. route: /v1/embeddings model: rwd-embed-1, batch path looks hot. attaching flamegraph snapshot in thread.
Carlos R.: quick look at infra metrics — embedding worker CPU and GPU mem on pool-7 are saturated, queue length climbing. Continuous-batching stalls when large seqs hit; backlog grows and admission starts failing requests. Likely a mix of bigger-than-normal batches + a few long requests. :thinking_face:
Emily S.: customer is on a support call asking for ETA. can we provide immediate mitigation steps?
Carlos R.: short-term mitigations we can apply now:
- route tenant_482 to rwd-embed-1-small (lower-latency quantized variant)
- reduce max_batch_size from 128 -> 32 for that tenant
- enable prefix KV cache for repeated prefix requests
- apply temporary fair-share weight to throttle noisy tenant before it starves others
I'll push a narrow config patch for tenant overrides. Example patch: 
```json
PATCH /cfg/admission
{
  "tenant_overrides": {
    "tenant_482": {
      "max_concurrency": 8,
      "batch_size": 32,
      "priority": 0.75,
      "route_preference": "rwd-embed-1-small",
      "enable_prefix_cache": true
    }
  }
}
```
Maya Patel: can you roll that now? customer on the call.
Carlos R.: will do — applying to staging then promote to prod. ETA ~8-10m.
deploy-bot: rollout started for config/admission (patch tenant_482) at 1776543270
Ajay Singh: infra is also spinning up extra embedding workers as a belt-and-suspenders move.
infra-bot: scaled autoscale-group embeddings-pool +2 -> new desired 18 at 1776543285. expected drain time ~4m.
Emily S.: customer updated — they report p95 dropping to ~2.1s and errors subsiding. asking us to monitor for 30m and confirm fix. :thumbsup:
Maya Patel: good — leave monitoring alarms on. follow-up action items: postmortem to cover why tenant_482 caused queueing (payload patterns, batching heuristics), and consider long-term fair-share + adaptive batch sizing per-tenant. I'll open a ticket in ENG-RELIABILITY.
Carlos R.: logging notes: capture batch-size distribution and sequence-length histogram for last 24h for that tenant, and add a regression alert on queue-length + batch-latency correlation.
Emily S.: thanks everyone, keeping customer updated.
